blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—The Judicial and Bar Council (JBC) will begin interviewing candidates for the next chief justice on Thursday, Oct. 22. The first to undergo the interviews will be the two most senior incumbent Supreme Court justices: Senior Associate Justice Marvic Leonen and Associate Justice Alfredo Benjamin Caguioa.
